name: Drum Incremental
summary: Drum Incremental is an incremental game built around real percussion rudiments. The player taps patterns on a practice pad using the left and right mouse buttons (with keyboard keys for flam and drag ornaments), earning Rhythm Points that unlock new rudiments and upgrades. The game features 40 rudiments from the PAS list across five progression phases, each gated by a boss exam judged by an on-screen teacher; a metronome with four speed tiers; a Study Companion that generates points passively, including while the game is closed; golden notes that fall during play; and a jam mode that recognizes the rudiments the player performs. The soundtrack is original and synchronized with the metronome tempo. Single-player, with full controller support and localization in ten languages. A free demo is planned for Steam Next Fest in October 2026, and the full game releases on Steam for Windows on November 2, 2026.
